tags.name: Carl
tags.validation_note: Re-audited 2026-08-05 (deep QA wreck-history research, >=2-source cross-check attempted). Directly queried OSM way 1137623285 — tags are limited to historic=wreck, seamark:type=wreck, name=Carl, no description or history fields. Searched wrecksite-style databases, Wikipedia (West Ice accidents — lists five different Norwegian sealers lost in 1952, none named Carl), and Danish-language queries ("Carl vraget Grønland") — no match. Found an unrelated wreck named "Greenland" off East Greenland (identified 2019 by Dr Innes McCartney/Bangor University, 74m depth, 80m length) via the Echoes from the Deep project; explicitly ruled OUT as a match — different name, different depth (74m vs OSM's 40m), no source connects it to this OSM entry, so it is NOT used here to avoid conflating two distinct wrecks. Also found German trawler "Carl Röver" (V 209) — ruled out, wrong theatre/context, no link to this location. CONCLUSION: vessel name 'Carl', build date, length, tonnage, nationality, and sinking cause remain unverified by any independent source. Previous fabricated description (wreck colonized by anemones and seals) remains correctly removed. Do not restore invented vessel history. validated remains false.

No dive operator or published source — including ScubaBoard, Advanced Diver Magazine, or Adrex.com — documents diving at this specific named site before or after the event. Marine life claims remain stripped. Access is expedition-only with no local infrastructure. 3-domain site-specific validation requirement not met; validated remains false.
